results.title: User-facing readiness proof (spec E2E-CORE-13.05)
results.desc: id -u must exit 0 with numeric UID; whoami may fail for rootless UIDs
results.prose: Random spec draw: e2e-testing.spec.md, scenario E2E-CORE-13.05 — the platform's own e2e suite uses `sandbox exec id -u` as the user-facing readiness proof, explicitly NOT whoami, because whoami exits non-zero for a rootless sandbox UID with no passwd entry. I replicated the scenario against this gateway: `id -u` returned the numeric UID 1000880000 with exit 0 — the readiness proof holds. `whoami` also succeeded here — milder than the spec's worst case, but id -u remains the portable proof.
results.steps: CreateSandbox; wait Ready; exec 'id -u; echo rc' (expect numeric UID, rc=0); exec 'whoami; echo rc' (spec: may fail for rootless UID); cleanup.
